reviews.text:
I found a fantastic veterinarian, available even without the app.
I recommend her.

We had our 1.5-year-old Golden Retriever's medical checkup and vaccinations.
The doctor is just as everyone describes her: very professional and kind.
Thank you, doctor, see you soon.

Truly an exceptional doctor! Always very knowledgeable, attentive, and meticulous in every visit. You can tell she loves her job and treats animals with great care and professionalism. Furthermore, a rare quality: she is extremely honest and transparent. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a competent and trustworthy veterinarian!

I've entrusted all my animals to Dr. Bevere's care. I've been using her services for years now, and I've always been satisfied. She's never misdiagnosed, which speaks volumes about her expertise. It's also clear that she loves animals and does her work with passion and dedication—in short, a true professional.

One final note: you'll NEVER find yourself spending money that's not strictly necessary for your pet's care, which is incredibly difficult to find with other vets who offer absurd proposals just to extort money from you. I'd like to close by thanking Nicoletta.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Simply incredible!
We've been going to her for several years, and we have four dogs, so we've been through a bit of everything😅. She's always been very attentive and helpful, explaining everything clearly and simply. What impressed us most was her professionalism: she never suggested unnecessary tests or medications, but only what was truly necessary.
Highly recommended!
Dr. Bevere is an extraordinary doctor. I'm so happy I brought my dog ​​to her. A true doctor, the likes of which are rare.
The doctor was very kind and thorough. She examined my dog ​​and provided a detailed diagnosis.

Our Jonsie, who had always been a healthy cat, developed serious health problems around the age of 10. Dr. Bevere immediately identified the problem, and emergency surgery was performed. With professionalism and without any illusions, we approached the process without stressing him with unnecessary tests, but only with what needed to be done! I recommend this 5-star doctor!

Dr. Bevere is one of the best veterinarians I've ever met: honest, competent, and straightforward. She never suggests unnecessary procedures (as unfortunately happens in many practices) just to increase the cost of the bill.
She's also the only one who responds on Sundays.
Enzino approves!
Extremely professional and prepared, empathetic with the owners and their masters.

This is the best doctor there is, never a wrong diagnosis, always right the first time, incredibly polite, kind, and empathetic. Excellent, trustworthy, and professional, nothing like those clinics where they rip you off.

Excellent organization, excellent professionals. I thank them for their meticulous care for my two recently adopted dogs. You can see and feel their passion for their work. Congratulations and thank you. See you soon.

I was reading the wonderful reviews and wanted to add my own. Dr. Bevere is very knowledgeable, thorough, kind, reasonable, and empathetic with humans and animals (all, dogs, cats, purebreds and otherwise). I'm incredibly lucky to have found her.
The doctor is always attentive and precise. I have 3 cats and I have known her for at least 20 years now... well done, well done.
Nicoletta the vet is precise, punctual and professional.
Attentive and knowledgeable professional. Dogs treated very well.
Today, further confirmation of Dr. Bevere's professionalism, expertise, love for animals, and honesty. A great doctor and a true human being, she's a shining light.

I've been taking my dog ​​for almost 9 years.
The doctor is very professional and loves animals.
This isn't something you can take for granted.

Dr. Bevere has proven to be extremely professional and empathetic. During my last two visits with my kitten, I felt welcomed and cared for with great attention. The prices are very fair, and the service provided is top-notch. I will definitely be back and highly recommend her practice!

Even though it's just after mid-August, the doctor saw my cat right away, as he wasn't feeling well. She's very professional and knowledgeable, kind, and always responsive. She'll definitely become my trusted vet for both my cat and my dog. Congratulations, excellent practice!

I needed a new vet.
I trusted the reviews and can only confirm their kindness, expertise, and honest pricing.
Highly recommended!

I live on the other side of town and have at least four veterinary practices within walking distance of my home, but my pets have been treated by Dr. Bevere for many years. I can only say good things about her: she's extremely competent, she tells you things as they are because she cares about your pet's well-being, and she doesn't inflict unnecessary suffering when the animal can't be treated further, as I've seen happen in other veterinary practices just for the sake of profit. She explains everything so you can understand every situation. To say she's fair with her prices is an understatement; it's borderline charitable, I'd say. My cat, who was practically doomed at 10, lived to be 22, thanks to her advice and care. I immediately recommended her to friends and acquaintances who asked me for a recommendation for a good vet, and they all thanked me.
Excellent veterinary doctor, kind and very professional, I recommend her
